svg.title: Containment delay and conditional cascade harm bounds
svg.desc: Two illustrative plots connect a covered containment-delay bound to a subcritical all-generation harm bound and to expected episodes by branching generation. The example identifies a fifteen-second threshold under its stated workload assumptions. It is not fitted to a population or deployment and does not show that cumulative harm decays. Source: Dr. Carsten Stöcker / Spherity GmbH. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

g.aria-label: Containment delay and conditional cascade bounds
Generation counts can decay; cumulative harm cannot. No population or deployment is fitted.
An upper matrix with spectral radius at least one does not prove growth in a finite network.
